v2.0: Added output protocol, CLI quick-start, multi-scenario auto-detection

Initial public release: Instantly generates full proposal documents from a single sentence, automatically identifying the context (government, business, or technical).  
- One-sentence input triggers a complete, standard-format proposal (background, goals, measures, assurance, results).  
- Scene recognition: auto-matches government, business, or technical templates based on keywords.  
- Varies style and depth by target audience (leaders, peers, executors).  
- Always outputs a fully usable document, not just a framework.  
- Includes built-in safeguards to ensure goals are measurable and actionable.
